Description: A brake-air leak on a trailer was found at the end of a trip; the trailer returned to the depot without incident.
Immediate Action Taken: Trailer removed from service for repair.

Description: Vehicle reversed into a customer-site bollard because no banksman was available.
Immediate Action Taken: Delivery completed with a second person guiding; damage noted.

Description: Oil drips under a compressor skid close to a warm surface.
Immediate Action Taken: Cleaned; leak referred to maintenance.

Description: Storage inspection dates are held on separate lists and not consolidated.
Immediate Action Taken: Consolidated register requested.

Description: Precautionary compressor shutdown after a gas-detector fault alarm; fault traced to a failed sensor head.
Immediate Action Taken: Unit shut down as designed, sensor replaced by vendor.
Actual Outcome: About four hours of lost production; no gas release.

Description: Transfer hoses left coiled on the ground rather than on the rack.
Immediate Action Taken: Hoses returned to rack.

Description: Hot work was about to start before the gas-test result was recorded on the permit.
Immediate Action Taken: Supervisor intervened; gas test performed and recorded.

Description: Valves on a maintenance line were unlabelled, making positive identification harder during isolation.
Immediate Action Taken: Valves labelled.

Description: Contractor induction records incomplete for two visiting technicians.
Immediate Action Taken: Induction completed before next visit.

Description: An isolation valve was found not fully closed during the zero-energy check before a flange was opened.
Immediate Action Taken: Work stopped; valve closed and re-verified; permit annotated.

Description: A visitor used a mobile phone close to the hazardous-area boundary.
Immediate Action Taken: Phone put away; visitor briefing reinforced.

Description: A relief-valve certification tag showed a test date past its interval.
Immediate Action Taken: Referred to Asset Integrity Engineer for competent-person review.

Description: Trailer pre-trip sheets completed inconsistently across drivers.
Immediate Action Taken: Standard sheet issued.

Description: A coupling was found only part-engaged by a second person before pressurisation began.
Immediate Action Taken: Transfer paused and coupling reseated; second-person check confirmed.

Description: A driver reported briefly losing concentration late in a long return leg and stopped at the next rest point.
Immediate Action Taken: Driver rested; dispatch revised the next day's plan.

Description: Oil film on the loading-bay floor near the hose rack.
Immediate Action Taken: Cleaned up; cleaning frequency increased.

Description: One impact bollard near the storage area was missing after earlier damage.
Immediate Action Taken: Temporary barrier placed; replacement requested.

Description: Operator slipped on an oily patch beside the loading bay and sprained a wrist.
Immediate Action Taken: First aid; area cleaned; operator returned to light duties.
Actual Outcome: First aid case; one shift of restricted work.

Description: An earthing cable end was found corroded at the loading bay.
Immediate Action Taken: Cable replaced.

Description: A hose with visible outer abrasion was noticed at the pre-transfer check and had been issued from the rack.
Immediate Action Taken: Hose tagged out and replaced.

Description: Several completed work permits had blank verification fields.
Immediate Action Taken: Permit audit scheduled.

Description: A low suction-pressure alarm was acknowledged but not investigated until the next round, where a trend was spotted.
Immediate Action Taken: Operator checked the supply line; trend reviewed by the supervisor.

Description: Minor gas weep detected at a hose end fitting during the post-connection leak check at a customer site.
Immediate Action Taken: Transfer stopped, line isolated, fitting replaced by competent person before resuming.
Actual Outcome: Small release, no injury, delivery delayed about 40 minutes.

Description: A person took a shortcut through the marked exclusion zone while a transfer was active.
Immediate Action Taken: Stopped by the supervisor.

Description: A trailer marker light was found inoperative at the pre-trip check.
Immediate Action Taken: Repaired before departure.

Description: A driver ran ahead of the planned driving hours to complete one extra delivery.
Immediate Action Taken: Driver stopped at the next rest point; dispatch informed.

Description: PPE issued is generic and not specified by task.
Immediate Action Taken: Task-based PPE assessment requested.

Description: Detector register has no calibration due dates recorded.
Immediate Action Taken: Register creation requested.

Description: Laden trailer broke down on a road shoulder with a brake-air fault; no gas release.
Immediate Action Taken: Hazard warning set out, dispatch notified, recovery arranged.
Actual Outcome: Delay and temporary lane obstruction; no release or injury.

Description: Loose cables and spare fittings in a workshop walkway.
Immediate Action Taken: Cleared; housekeeping round added.

Description: Smoking was seen just outside the marked hazardous-area boundary near the yard.
Immediate Action Taken: Person redirected to the designated area; signs reviewed.

Description: Refresher training records missing for several operators.
Immediate Action Taken: Training matrix requested.

Description: A single driver made the connection at a customer site where the procedure calls for a second person.
Immediate Action Taken: Reviewed with the driver; second person assigned.

Description: A technician handled hoses without gloves.
Immediate Action Taken: Corrected on the spot; briefed at toolbox talk.

Description: A hose coil was lifted by one person with a poor posture.
Immediate Action Taken: Technique corrected; lifting aid provided.

Description: A third-party delivery vehicle drove into the marked exclusion area during a transfer.
Immediate Action Taken: Supervisor stopped the vehicle and paused the transfer until it left.

Description: One fixed gas detector displayed a fault state for two shifts before being reported.
Immediate Action Taken: Reported; sensor replaced.

Description: A pre-trip checklist was ticked without all items being physically checked.
Immediate Action Taken: Driver re-did the checks; reviewed with Fleet Manager.
Actual Outcome: No defect missed on this occasion.

Description: Contractor technician received a minor burn from an uninsulated hot surface during routine work.
Immediate Action Taken: First aid given; area marked.

Description: A bypass key was left in a panel after a test.
Immediate Action Taken: Key returned; key control reinforced.

Description: Emergency contact list for route incidents is out of date.
Immediate Action Taken: List updated and posted.

Description: A workshop emergency exit partly blocked by stored materials.
Immediate Action Taken: Cleared; storage area marked.

Description: The access road at a new customer site was too narrow for a safe turn; delivery aborted before the trailer neared live equipment.
Immediate Action Taken: Delivery rescheduled; site referred to Logistics.

Description: A reversing truck stopped short of the storage protection line after the driver saw the bollards.
Immediate Action Taken: Driver briefed; reversing route reviewed.

Description: An emergency shutdown push-button partly hidden behind stored equipment.
Immediate Action Taken: Equipment moved; button area marked.

Description: A car cut across the path of a laden trailer; the driver braked and avoided contact.
Immediate Action Taken: Driver reported to dispatch; no vehicle damage.

Description: A driver reversed at a customer site without a guide.
Immediate Action Taken: Stopped by the receiving customer's staff; driver coached.

Description: Muster point headcount did not reconcile with the visitor log in an unannounced drill.
Immediate Action Taken: Visitor log process reviewed.

Description: Annual drill programme has no tube-trailer release scenario.
Immediate Action Taken: Scenario added to the programme for next quarter.

Description: The padlock on the storage-area gate was found broken.
Immediate Action Taken: Gate secured with a temporary lock; replacement fitted.

Description: Small lubricating-oil leak from a compressor skid reached the yard drain before it was contained.
Immediate Action Taken: Leak stopped, spill kit used, drain cleaned.

Description: The handheld radio failed during a transfer and the operator could not reach the control room.
Immediate Action Taken: Transfer stopped as the procedure requires until communication was restored.

Description: Trailer mirror struck a gatepost while manoeuvring in the depot yard.
Immediate Action Taken: Vehicle checked, damage recorded, no gas equipment affected.

Description: A contractor began a task before the work permit had been signed.
Immediate Action Taken: Work stopped by the supervisor and permit completed.

Description: Exclusion-zone floor markings faded and partly invisible.
Immediate Action Taken: Re-marked; signs checked.

Description: The trailer earthing clamp was not attached; caught when the transfer checklist was read back.
Immediate Action Taken: Transfer held until earthing was connected.

Description: Worn tread on a trailer access step.
Immediate Action Taken: Step replaced.

Description: An operator noticed a gas odour and waited about ten minutes before reporting it; a minor seep was later confirmed and isolated.
Immediate Action Taken: Area checked with fixed detection and by the supervisor; fitting tightened by a competent person.

Description: A small-bore fitting on discharge piping showed a slight weep in the leak check.
Immediate Action Taken: Isolated and referred to a competent person.

Description: A high-vibration alarm inhibited during troubleshooting was not restored at shift handover; found on rounds.
Immediate Action Taken: Inhibit removed and logged.
